usage: 腸粉 is used as a noun to refer to a specific type of food, steamed rice noodle rolls.
It can be the subject of a sentence, for example, '腸粉好味' means 'Rice noodle rolls are delicious.'
You can also use it as the object in a sentence, like '我想食腸粉' which means 'I want to eat rice noodle rolls.'
腸粉 often appears in questions, such as '你食過腸粉未？' meaning 'Have you eaten rice noodle rolls before?'
When describing it, you can add adjectives or other modifiers, for example, '熱辣辣嘅腸粉' meaning 'hot and spicy rice noodle rolls.'
